newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Italy deficit/GDP ratio may fall further in 97-EU.
newsitem.headline: Italy deficit/GDP ratio may fall further in 97-EU.

text.p: The European Commission said in its economic forecasts for 1997 that it was still examining whether Italy's deficit to GDP ratio could be cut by a further 0.3 percent in 1997.

It gave no details but said "other measures (comprising 0.3 percent of GDP) are still under examination and contribute to the explanation of the difference between the national and the Commission forecast."
